title: LLM judge over an OpenAI-compatible endpoint
spec: Add src/judge/llm.ts: LlmJudge({ complete, model, fallbackModel }) where complete({ model, system, user, maxTokens }) → { text } is injected (no HTTP in this module). Prompt: the donor's SYSTEM line (grade content against spec and private reference; commentary around a correct answer is not a failure). Parse SCORE=<0..1> REASON=<text>; pass at score ≥ 0.6. Try the fallback model when the primary throws; if both throw return a failing verdict with reasons ["judge unavailable: ..."] and score omitted. The deliverable is cut to 6000 chars. Never include the reference answer in anything returned to the payee.
done: With a scripted complete(), the judge maps recorded model outputs to the expected verdicts and falls back correctly.
